assets.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: landscape website card image for a medical college pharmacy program and pharmaceutical training lab. Primary request: a sophisticated photorealistic editorial image of a pharmacy training workbench in a bright modern academic laboratory. Main subject: amber glass medicine bottles without readable labels, a ceramic mortar and pestle, a capsule tray and neatly arranged glass measuring cylinders on a spotless pale stone bench; laboratory shelving softly blurred behind. Composition: landscape 3:2, eye level with close foreground detail and comfortable breathing room, main objects centered so a wide card crop stays useful. Lighting: soft natural daylight, subtle navy and teal accents matching a professional medical college website, realistic glass reflections. Constraints: a representative educational scene rather than a specific real campus; no people, no text, no logos, no watermark, no fake interface, no graphic overlay. Polished yet believable real-world photographic materials.
